reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: p0073 imposes an audit obligation on Licensee with no frequency cap, no advance-notice requirement (the 30 days is a deadline to permit, not notice), no business-hours/off-site limit, no system-access restriction and no auditor confidentiality undertaking.

Redline reaches the preferred position by inserting frequency (once per 12 months), 30 days' prior written notice, business hours, off-site where practicable, no system access and auditor confidentiality, while preserving the independent/mutually-selected auditor language.
High changed-character ratio (0.820) is justified here: the offending sentence had to be replaced to carry the multiple required parameters; the rest of the clause is untouched.
Comment is accurate (cost allocation in p0064 already matches the 5% preferred split), cites the playbook position and offers the 15-day fallback in the required tone.

Minor nit for negotiation: barring access to Licensee's 'premises' outright sits awkwardly with 'off-site wherever practicable' and goes slightly beyond the playbook's 'no direct access to Customer systems'; consider limiting the carve-out to systems/networks.
